name: Brawler Madcap
body:
You are a daredevil, a pugilist, and a rebel, always living life on the edge. Whether you’re performing an amazing feat of acrobatics or throwing yourself in harm’s way to defend the innocent, you’re sure to amaze everyone with your drive and ability to improvise in any situation.

Madcap Training (Ex)

At 1st level, you gain a vigilante talent of your choice, using your brawler level as your effective vigilante level. For the purposes of using these talents, you are always considered to be in your vigilante identity.

You gain another vigilante talent at 3rd level and every four levels thereafter.

This feature replaces martial flexibility.

Martial Flexibility (Ex)

At 6th level, you can use a move action to gain the benefit of a combat feat you don’t possess. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

You must meet the chosen feat’s prerequisites.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1/2 your brawler level. You can use this ability again before the duration expires in order to replace your previously chosen combat feat with another choice. If a combat feat has a daily use limitation (such as Stunning Fist), any uses of that combat feat while using this ability count toward that feat’s daily limit. At higher levels, when you gain multiple feats through this ability, you can use those feats to meet the prerequisites of other feats you gain with this ability. Doing so means you cannot replace a feat currently fulfilling another’s prerequisite without also replacing those feats that require it. Each individual feat selected counts toward your daily uses of this ability.

At 10th level, you can use this ability to gain the benefit of two combat feats at the same time. You can select one feat as a swift action or two feats as a move action.

At 14th level, you can use this ability to gain the benefit of three combat feats at the same time. You can select one feat as a free action, two feats as a swift action, or three feats as a move action.

At 17th level, you can use this ability to gain the benefit of one combat feat as an immediate action or three combat feats as a swift action.

At 20th level, you can use this ability to gain the benefit of any number of combat feats as a swift action. Each feat selected counts toward your daily uses of this ability, and can be used as a prerequisite for any of the other feats.

This feature replaces maneuver training and knockout.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
